verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents cloud mock servers that can be created in a few steps, plus self-hosted mock servers via Insomnia Mockbin. Mock servers can be auto-generated from an OpenAPI definition, a JSON input or a live URL, scaffolding routes and responses, and dynamic mocking adds Liquid-templated request data and fake data. Together these let consumers build before the API exists. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating mocks from saved request examples, a non-AI spec-to-mock path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
